messages:
omar t: nightly SAST started failing with KMS 403 during artifact decrypt. Noticed after RBAC cleanup last night.

ci-bot: build 9842 failed: artifact-decrypt error 403 for serviceAccount:scanners@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com

lina v: can you grab the job log to see which principal ran the step? sometimes scheduled jobs get different impersonation.

omar t: log shows runner impersonating serviceAccount:build-orch@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com

audit-bot: recent SetIamPolicy on infra-key by lee.lee@redwood.ai at 2026-03-22T22:11:02Z

lina v: build-orch doesn't have encrypter/decrypter on infra-key. likely a mapping drift after the RBAC change.

omar t: quick mitigation: granted ephemeral decrypt role to build-orch and retried. SAST passed on rerun.

security-bot: incident SEC-3642001234 created and assigned to lina v (P2)

lina v: followups: 1) add PR lint that flags infra-config changes that touch runner impersonation without matching KMS bindings, 2) add log alert for SetIamPolicy on infra KMS keys, 3) update SDLC security checklist to include verifying key bindings when changing runner SAs.

omar t: also change scanner tooling to classify infra/auth failures as TOOLS-FAIL and avoid creating vuln tickets until a rescan confirms.

lina v: I'll open INFRA-901 (canonical runner->SA mapping + weekly reconciliation) and SEC-672 (KMS IAM alert + runbook). Thanks all. :thumbsup:
